title: Razkadr preset
description: Domain scenario preset (naryad 013): which frame roles the document needs, how they are searched (queries) and scored (weights), their quotas and constraints. A preset is pure data: adding a role or a preset must not require code changes. See docs/presets.md.

schema_version.description: Preset schema version, semver (patch may be omitted). This schema validates major version 1 only.

name.description: Stable preset identifier used in config and CLI (--preset recipe).

title.description: Human-readable preset name shown in UI and reports.

description.description: Free-form note about the scenario: what the preset is for, where the numbers come from.

roles.description: Role name -> role spec. Role names are free (except they must not collide with reserved JSON keys); the selection stage (naryad 014) consumes them as-is.

order.description: Document order of roles; must list every role exactly once (loader checks).

min_step_gap_s.description: Minimal gap in seconds between consecutive episodes of the same role (e.g. steps must not cluster on one scene).

min.description: Minimum number of episodes of this role in the storyboard.

max.description: Maximum number of episodes; null means unlimited.

queries.description: Search queries per language (v1: ru, en); at least one language, at least one query each.

weights.description: Search signal -> weight in [0,1]; the loader requires the weights to sum to 1 (the exact signal set is defined by the selection stage, naryad 014).

constraints.description: Hard quality constraints and demerits applied to candidate frames of this role.

min_sharpness.description: Frames below this normalized sharpness are not candidates.

face_penalty.description: Score demerit when a face detector fires in the frame.

hands_penalty.description: Score demerit when a hand detector fires in the frame.

candidates.description: How many top candidate frames to consider for this role.

alternatives.description: How many runner-up frames to keep as alternatives in the Storyboard.
